capabilities: Collect checkbox tasks from all vault notes into one sortable list
Sort, group and filter tasks by urgency, due date, priority, tag or note
Check off, reschedule and reprioritize tasks, writing changes back to the task's own line
Insert due dates, times and priorities on checklist lines with @ suggestions or commands
Add new tasks to a configurable inbox note
extras: Part of the author's offline-focused plugin suite (DoomEsque theme, Pomodoro Flashcards, Whole-Tree Search, etc.); not yet in the community plugin store, so installation is via BRAT or manual download; the manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
motivation: The author created it so they could be certain of zero network calls or traffic, using Obsidian for notes during open-book law exams.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in view that gathers all checkbox tasks across a vault into one place where they can be sorted, grouped, filtered and edited without leaving the list.

relations.evidence: tasks written for the Tasks or Dataview plugins work as they are
so tasks written for the Tasks or Dataview plugins work as they are
they do not interfere with Inline Autocomplete

summary: Collects every checkbox task in the vault into one list that sorts by urgency, due date, time or priority, with edits written back to the source note.
